content:
ben: FYI — after the regional edge egress tightening change this morning a subset of GPU warm-pool nodes in us-west-2 failed to finish provisioning. seeing KMS signer errors and short-circuiting of instance bootstrap.

maria: @ben can you paste the bootstrap logs? is this the new keystore policy from last week's audit rollout?

ben: pasting snippet from the node that failed: ```
ERROR: failed to fetch kms-signature: rpc deadline exceeded
WARN: keystore: unauthorized to decrypt key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01
INFO: fallback: quitting warm-pool attach, marking node unhealthy
```

ben: provisioning path goes: subnet->privatelink->egress-nat->kms-signer. after the firewall rules tightened, some privatelink endpoints started returning 403 on the KMS signed-call.

sam: Do we have a correlation with the new NACL rule that denies 443 to S3 endpoints? That could break signer uploads if the signer proxies out to a control-plane S3 bucket.

ben: I ran tcpdump on an affected node — CONTROL_PLANE_SIGNER 10.23.5.14:443 refused, TLS handshake reset. Haven't verified S3 yet.

maria: This smells like the keystore change (jenna's PR) that scoped the signer role to a specific VPC endpoint. If the endpoint IPs changed due to ASG churn and egress was tightened to CIDR ranges, signer calls might be dropping.

jing: Checked audit-logs — looks like KMS Decrypt requests are missing for those node ids during the window 08:03-08:12. Cloudtrail shows throttled PutObject to control-plane S3 from signer service around 08:05.

ops-bot: incident created: #inc-3745 — gpu-provisioning-warmpool-egress-kms-fail (severity: medium)

sam: Action plan I suggest: 1) revert the last NACL change for the affected subnets to allow egress to the signer endpoint IPs; 2) temporarily allow S3 PutObject from signer role; 3) collect a full node bootstrap trace.

maria: Before reverting, can we enumerate the exact signer endpoints and map them to the VPC endpoint policy? If the keystore PR tightened IAM to a role bound to specific endpoint IDs, reverting NACLs may be fine but we should also update the endpoint mapping.

ben: signer endpoints observed in logs: signer-01.cp.internal (10.23.5.14), signer-02.cp.internal (10.23.5.21). VPC endpoint ids: vpce-0a1b2c3, vpce-0d4e5f6 (from last deployment).

jing: I can run a sweep to check which warmpool AZs still healthy and which hit the KMS Decrypt error. Quick query: `SELECT node_id, az, status FROM warmpool_nodes WHERE last_bootstrap_error LIKE '%kms%' AND ts > '2024-07-24T08:00:00Z'`

ben: results (sample): node-782 (us-west-2b) KMS Decrypt failed; node-789 (us-west-2c) OK; node-794 (us-west-2b) failed. looks AZ-bounded, pointing to an egress path difference.

sam: OK. I'll open an emergency rule to re-add egress to signer endpoint CIDRs for the affected subnets and watch. If that clears provisioning, we can do a safer config change: add explicit VPC endpoint policy entries for the signer role and update NACLs with a documented allow list.

maria: Also we need to ensure audit logging is intact for these signer calls. Jing, can you follow up on missing CloudTrail entries? We want to know if requests were blocked by NACL (network) vs IAM policy.

jing: On it. Quick note — control-plane metrics show a spike in 403s from signer service at 08:05 and a corresponding spike in PutObject retries. That matches the node bootstrap failures.

ben: After sam's temporary revert, two warmpool nodes in us-west-2b completed bootstrap at 08:10 and joined cluster. cpu/gpu health looks normal.

maria: Good — still want a postmortem: include the chain (keystore policy change + NACL tighten + endpoint IP churn) and proposed mitigation: 1) signer endpoint stable DNS and not rely on ephemeral IPs; 2) VPC endpoint policy sync with deploys; 3) egress allowlist automation; 4) alert when KMS Decrypt error rates spike during provisioning.

sam: I'll add a canary job that boots a warmpool node after any network-security change and validates keystore decrypts, pushes audit log to a retained bucket.

ben: Logging snippets and the bootstrap trace uploaded to the #inc-3745 ticket.

maria: Note for compliance: we must retain the CloudTrail segment for the window and include it in the incident packet for SOC review. I'll also open a short change advisory for the keystore rollout to include endpoint mapping.

ben: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a small PR to annotate the signer endpoints in the infra repo and a runbook entry for warmpool egress requirements.

ops-bot: incident #inc-3745 updated: runbook added (author: sam), severity unchanged.

sam: tl;dr — cause: tightened egress + keystore role scoping + endpoint IP churn -> KMS signer calls blocked -> warmpool nodes failed bootstrap. Mitigations: temporary egress allow, endpoint mapping + automation, postmortem + KMS alert. :white_check_mark:
